verdict.rationale: Anrok markets autonomous background processes such as automatic registration, hands-off filing/payments, and proactive threshold alerts, and its Headless Tax API explicitly says tax logic can be 'handed to your agents' — evidence of background automation beyond manual UI use ([anrok-docs-28],[anrok-docs-41],[anrok-docs-20],[anrok-docs-30]). However, there's no detail on how a user actually configures/schedules these automations, no independent/hands-on confirmation of autonomous operation, and API docs endpoints (openapi/llms.txt) return 404 in probes, limiting verification. Missing for 10: user-facing automation setup/configuration workflow, independent verification of unattended operation, working public API reference.
